// ==================== МОДЕЛИ ====================

класс данных Word(
    ключ значения: строка,
    val level: String,
    val word: String,
    val pos: String,
    val ipa: String,
    val us: String,
    val tr: List<String>,
    val example: String,
    val exampleRu: String,
    val emoji: String
)

класс данных Prog(
    val s: Int, // 1..5 = шаги интервалов (1, 3, 7, 14, 30 дн.), 6 = Закреплено
    Срок выполнения: Долгосрочный,
    val mastered: Boolean,
    val intro: Long,
    val lapses: Int,
    val lastWrong: Long
)

класс данных Quiz(val text: String, val options: List<String>, val answer: Int)

класс данных GUnit(
    val id: String,
    val level: String,
    val title: String,
    val rule: String,
    val formula: String,
    Примеры значений: List<String>,
    Ошибка val: Строка,
    val quiz: List<Quiz>
)

класс данных TextItem(
    val id: String,
    val level: String,
    val title: String,
    val body: String,
    Вопросы: Список<Викторина>
)

класс данных Термин(
    val title: String,
    Ключевые слова: List<String>,
    val explain: String,
    val example: String,
    val wiki: String
)

класс данных Q(
    ключ значения: строка,
    val section: String, // "grammar", "vocab", "reading"
    val level: String,
    val text: String,
    val options: List<String>, // Если пусто — вопрос с вводом ввода с клавиатуры
    val answer: Int,
    val acceptedTyped: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val tip: String,
    val wordKey: String? = null,
    val unitId: String? = null,
    val passage: String? = null
)

класс данных TestRec(val day: Long, val kind: String, val level: String, val percent: Int, val passed: Boolean)

class Res(val ok: Boolean, val fixed: String?, val info: String)
class Medal(val title: String, val desc: String, val done: Boolean, val frac: Float, val label: String)
class WrongItem(val q: Q, val userText: String, val rightText: String)
класс TestResult(
    val percent: Int,
    val passed: Boolean,
    val newLevel: String?,
    val sections: List<Pair<String, Int>>,
    val wrong: List<WrongItem>
)

class TestSession(val kind: String, val target: String, val qs: List<Q>, val initialSec: Int) {
    индекс переменной по mutableStateOf(0)
    var remainingSec by mutableStateOf(initialSec)
    val choiceAnswers = mutableStateListOf<Int>().also { l -> repeat(qs.size) { l.add(-1) } }
    val typedAnswers = mutableStateListOf<String>().also { l -> repeat(qs.size) { l.add("") } }
    var result by mutableStateOf<TestResult?>(null)
}

// ===================== ПОЛНЫЙ КУРС ГРАММАТИКИ A0–C2 (105 ЮНИТОВ • 525 ВОПРОСОВ) =====================
// 15 фундаментальных юнитов на каждый из 7 уровней (A0, A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2).
// Каждый уровень выделен в отдельный object (отдельный .class файл JVM) по 3 части (5 юнитов в методе).

// -------------------- ГРАММАТИКА УРОВНЯ A0 (15 ЮНИТОВ • 75 ВОПРОСОВ) --------------------
private object GrammarA0 {

        "Present Simple (настоящее простое время) описывает всё, что происходит регулярно, по расписанию или является постоянным фактом: где ты живёшь, что любишь и что делаешь каждый день. С местоимениями I, you, we, they глагол берётся в начальной форме (I work, they read). Но когда подлежащее — он, она или оно (he, she, it), к глаголу обязательно прибавляется окончание -s / -es (he works, she watches, it flies). В вопросах и отрицаниях на помощь приходят вспомогательные глаголы do и does — и тогда основной глагол возвращается в чистую форму без -s!",

    GUnit(

        listOf(
            Quiz(

            ),
            Quiz(

            ),

                    "- / -",
                    "the / a"
                ),
                1
            ),
            Quiz(
                "___ Mount Kilimanjaro is the highest peak in ___ Africa.",
                listOf(
                    "The / the",
                    "- / -",
                    "The / -",
                    "- / the"
                ),
                1
            ),
            Quiz(

                listOf(
                    "- / -",
                    "the / the",
                    "the / -",
                    "- / the"
                ),
                1
            )
        )
    )
    )

    fun all(): List<GUnit> = listOf(part1(), part2(), part3()).flatten()
}

    "understood" to "understand",
    "chose" to "choose", "chosen" to "choose",
    "built" to "build",
    "kept" to "keep",
    "left" to "leave",
    "lost" to "lose",
    "met" to "meet",
    "paid" to "pay",
    "said" to "say",
    "sent" to "send",
    "spent" to "spend",
    "stood" to "stand",
    "told" to "tell",
    "won" to "win",
    "wore" to "wear", "worn" to "wear",
    "swam" to "swim", "swum" to "swim",
    "children" to "child", "men" to "man", "women" to "woman", "leaves" to "leaf",
    "better" to "good", "best" to "good", "worse" to "bad", "worst" to "bad"
)

// ===================== ПОМОЩНИКИ =====================

fun parseCsv(text: String): List<List<String>> {
    val rows = ArrayList<List<String>>()
    var row = ArrayList<String>()
    val sb = StringBuilder()
    var q = false
    val t = text.removePrefix("\uFEFF")
    var i = 0
    while (i < t.length) {
        val c = t[i]
        if (q) {
            if (c == '"') {
                if (i + 1 < t.length && t[i + 1] == '"') {
                    sb.append('"')
                    i++
                } else {
                    q = false
                }
            } else {
                sb.append(c)
            }
        } else if (c == '"') {
            q = true
        } else if (c == ';') {
            row.add(sb.toString())
            sb.setLength(0)
        } else if (c == '\n') {
            row.add(sb.toString())
            sb.setLength(0)
            rows.add(row)
            row = ArrayList()
        } else if (c != '\r') {
            sb.append(c)
        }
        i++
    }
    if (sb.isNotEmpty() || row.isNotEmpty()) {
        row.add(sb.toString())
        rows.add(row)
    }
    return rows
}

fun parseWords(text: String): List<Word> {
    val out = ArrayList<Word>()
    for (r in parseCsv(text)) {
        if (r.size < 9) continue
        val level = r[1].trim().uppercase()
        val w = r[2].trim()
        if (w.isEmpty() || level !in LEVELS) continue
        val tr = r[6].split("|").map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
        if (tr.isEmpty()) continue
        out.add(
            Word(
                w.lowercase(), level, w.lowercase(), r[3].trim(), r[4].trim(), r[5].trim(), tr,
                r[8].trim(), r.getOrElse(9) { "" }.trim(), r.getOrElse(10) { "" }.trim()
            )
        )
    }
    return out
}

// loadDefaultSeedWords() определен выше через объекты DictA0..DictC2

fun norm(s: String): String =
    s.lowercase().replace('ё', 'е').filter { it.isLetterOrDigit() || it == ' ' }.trim().replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ")

fun lev(a: String, b: String): Int {
    if (a == b) return 0
    if (a.isEmpty()) return b.length
    if (b.isEmpty()) return a.length
    var prev = IntArray(b.length + 1) { it }
    for (i in 1..a.length) {
        val cur = IntArray(b.length + 1)
        cur[0] = i
        for (j in 1..b.length) {
            val cost = if (a[i - 1] == b[j - 1]) 0 else 1
            cur[j] = minOf(prev[j] + 1, cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j - 1] + cost)
        }
        prev = cur
    }
    return prev[b.length]
}

fun wordAt(s: String, off: Int): String? {
    if (s.isEmpty()) return null
    var a = off.coerceIn(0, s.length - 1)
    var b = a
    if (!(s[a].isLetter() || s[a] == '\'')) return null
    while (a > 0 && (s[a - 1].isLetter() || s[a - 1] == '\'')) a--
    while (b < s.length - 1 && (s[b + 1].isLetter() || s[b + 1] == '\'')) b++
    return s.substring(a, b + 1).lowercase().removeSuffix("'s").removeSuffix("’s")
}

/**
 * Умный морфологический поиск слова из текста в словаре:
 * учитывает неправильные формы, -ies -> -y, -ied -> -y, удвоение согласных (stopped -> stop, swimming -> swim),
 * немое -e (making -> make) и американские/британские варианты.
 */
fun findWordInDict(rawWord: String, allWords: List<Word>): Word? {
    val w = rawWord.lowercase().trim()
    val candidates = LinkedHashSet<String>()
    candidates.add(w)
    IRREGULAR_STEMS[w]?.let { candidates.add(it) }
    if (w.endsWith("ies") && w.length > 4) candidates.add(w.dropLast(3) + "y")
    if (w.endsWith("ied") && w.length > 4) candidates.add(w.dropLast(3) + "y")
    if (w.endsWith("es") && w.length > 3) candidates.add(w.dropLast(2))
    if (w.endsWith("s") && w.length > 2) candidates.add(w.dropLast(1))
    if (w.endsWith("ed") && w.length > 3) {
        val stem = w.dropLast(2)
        candidates.add(stem)
        candidates.add(stem + "e")
        if (stem.length >= 3 && stem.last() == stem[stem.length - 2]) {
            candidates.add(stem.dropLast(1))
        }
    }
    if (w.endsWith("d") && w.length > 2) candidates.add(w.dropLast(1))
    if (w.endsWith("ing") && w.length > 4) {
        val stem = w.dropLast(3)
        candidates.add(stem)
        candidates.add(stem + "e")
        if (stem.length >= 3 && stem.last() == stem[stem.length - 2]) {
            candidates.add(stem.dropLast(1))
        }
    }
    if (w.endsWith("ly") && w.length > 4) candidates.add(w.dropLast(2))
    if (w.endsWith("er") && w.length > 4) candidates.add(w.dropLast(2))
    if (w.endsWith("est") && w.length > 5) candidates.add(w.dropLast(3))

    for (cand in candidates) {
        val match = allWords.firstOrNull { it.key == cand || it.us.lowercase() == cand }
        if (match != null) return match
    }
    return null
}

fun fmt1(x: Float): String = String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", x)

fun daysWord(n: Int): String = if (n % 10 == 1 && n % 100 != 11) "день" else "дней"

fun sectionName(sec: String): String = when (sec) {
    "grammar" -> "Грамматика"
    "vocab" -> "Лексика"
    else -> "Чтение"
}

fun Context.toast(msg: String) {
    Toast.makeText(this, msg, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
}

// ===================== ЛОГИКА =====================

class AppVm(app: Application) : AndroidViewModel(app) {
    private val stateFile = File(app.filesDir, "state_v2_full.json")
    private val wordsFile = File(app.filesDir, "words.csv")
    private var baseWords: List<Word> = emptyList()

    var words by mutableStateOf<List<Word>>(emptyList())
        private set
    val prog = mutableStateMapOf<String, Prog>()
    val days = mutableStateMapOf<Long, Int>()
    val unitPassed = mutableStateMapOf<String, Boolean>()
    val unitReview = mutableStateMapOf<String, Boolean>()
    val tests = mutableStateListOf<TestRec>()
    val custom = mutableStateListOf<Word>()
    val pinned = mutableStateListOf<String>()
    val recentQKeys = mutableStateMapOf<String, Long>() // Исключение повтора вопросов за 4 недели (28 дней)

    var level by mutableStateOf("A0")
    var startDone by mutableStateOf(false)
    var limit by mutableStateOf(10)
    var accent by mutableStateOf("UK")
    var nextTest by mutableStateOf(0L)
    var newPaused by mutableStateOf(false)

    // Текущая сессия теста и флаг паузы (если закрыть экран теста, он ждёт на паузе и не сбрасывается!)
    var test by mutableStateOf<TestSession?>(null)
    var testOpenOnScreen by mutableStateOf(false)

    private var pending = 0
    private var lastTouch = System.currentTimeMillis()

    init {
        val defaultSeed = loadDefaultSeedWords()
        val customCsvWords = runCatching {
            if (wordsFile.exists()) parseWords(wordsFile.readText()) else emptyList()
        }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
        // Объединяем встроенный словарь из 525 слов Oxford с любым загруженным пользователем словарём
        val combinedBase = LinkedHashMap<String, Word>()
        for (w in defaultSeed + customCsvWords) combinedBase[w.key] = w
        baseWords = combinedBase.values.toList()

        runCatching { if (stateFile.exists()) load(JSONObject(stateFile.readText())) }
        rebuild()
        updatePause()
    }

    fun today(): Long = LocalDate.now().toEpochDay()

    private fun rebuild() {
        val m = LinkedHashMap<String, Word>()
        for (w in baseWords + custom) m.putIfAbsent(w.key, w)
        words = m.values.sortedBy { LEVELS.indexOf(it.level) }
    }

    // ---------- сохранение ----------

    private fun toJson(): JSONObject {
        val o = JSONObject()
        o.put("level", level)
        o.put("startDone", startDone)
        o.put("limit", limit)
        o.put("accent", accent)
        o.put("nextTest", nextTest)
        o.put("newPaused", newPaused)
        val p = JSONObject()
        for ((k, v) in prog) {
            p.put(k, JSONArray(listOf(v.s, v.due, if (v.mastered) 1 else 0, v.intro, v.lapses, v.lastWrong)))
        }
        o.put("prog", p)
        val d = JSONObject()
        for ((k, v) in days) d.put(k.toString(), v)
        o.put("days", d)
        o.put("unitsPassed", JSONArray(unitPassed.filter { it.value }.keys.toList()))
        o.put("unitsReview", JSONArray(unitReview.filter { it.value }.keys.toList()))
        o.put("tests", JSONArray(tests.map { JSONArray(listOf(it.day, it.kind, it.level, it.percent, if (it.passed) 1 else 0)) }))
        o.put("custom", JSONArray(custom.map { JSONArray(listOf(it.word, it.level, it.tr.joinToString("|"), it.example, it.exampleRu)) }))
        o.put("pinned", JSONArray(pinned.toList()))
        val rq = JSONObject()
        for ((k, v) in recentQKeys) rq.put(k, v)
        o.put("recentQ", rq)
        return o
    }

    private fun load(o: JSONObject) {
        level = o.optString("level", "A0").let { if (it in LEVELS) it else "A0" }
        startDone = o.optBoolean("startDone", false)
        limit = o.optInt("limit", 10)
        accent = o.optString("accent", "UK")
        nextTest = o.optLong("nextTest", 0L)
        newPaused = o.optBoolean("newPaused", false)
        prog.clear(); days.clear(); unitPassed.clear(); unitReview.clear()
        tests.clear(); custom.clear(); pinned.clear(); recentQKeys.clear()
        o.optJSONObject("prog")?.let { p ->
            for (k in p.keys()) {
                val a = p.getJSONArray(k)
                prog[k] = Prog(a.getInt(0), a.getLong(1), a.getInt(2) == 1, a.getLong(3), a.getInt(4), a.getLong(5))
            }
        }
        o.optJSONObject("days")?.let { d ->
            for (k in d.keys()) days[k.toLong()] = d.getInt(k)
        }
        o.optJSONArray("unitsPassed")?.let { a ->
            for (i in 0 until a.length()) unitPassed[a.getString(i)] = true
        }
        o.optJSONArray("unitsReview")?.let { a ->
            for (i in 0 until a.length()) unitReview[a.getString(i)] = true
        }
        o.optJSONArray("tests")?.let { a ->
            for (i in 0 until a.length()) {
                val r = a.getJSONArray(i)
                tests.add(TestRec(r.getLong(0), r.getString(1), r.getString(2), r.getInt(3), r.getInt(4) == 1))
            }
        }
        o.optJSONArray("custom")?.let { a ->
            for (i in 0 until a.length()) {
                val r = a.getJSONArray(i)
                val w = r.getString(0)
                custom.add(Word(w.lowercase(), r.getString(1), w, "", "", "", r.getString(2).split("|"), r.getString(3), r.getString(4), ""))
            }
        }
        o.optJSONArray("pinned")?.let { a ->
            for (i in 0 until a.length()) pinned.add(a.getString(i))
        }
        o.optJSONObject("recentQ")?.let { rq ->
            for (k in rq.keys()) recentQKeys[k] = rq.getLong(k)
        }
    }

    fun save() {
        val s = toJson().toString()
        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) { runCatching { stateFile.writeText(s) } }
    }

    fun exportJson(): String = toJson().toString(2)

    fun importBackup(text: String): Boolean = try {
        load(JSONObject(text))
        rebuild()
        updatePause()
        save()
        true
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        false
    }

    fun importCsv(text: String): Int {
        val parsed = parseWords(text)
        if (parsed.isEmpty()) return 0
        runCatching { wordsFile.writeText(text) }
        val combined = LinkedHashMap<String, Word>()
        for (w in loadDefaultSeedWords() + parsed) combined[w.key] = w
        baseWords = combined.values.toList()
        rebuild()
        updatePause()
        return parsed.size
    }

    // ---------- время и стрик ----------

    fun touch() {
        lastTouch = System.currentTimeMillis()
    }

    fun tick(countStudyTime: Boolean) {
        val activeTouch = System.currentTimeMillis() - lastTouch <= 120_000L
        if (countStudyTime && activeTouch) {
            pending++
            if (pending >= 10) flush()
        }
        // Обратный отсчёт Теста недели идёт ТОЛЬКО пока тест открыт на экране
        val curTest = test
        if (testOpenOnScreen && curTest != null && curTest.result == null && curTest.initialSec > 0) {
            if (curTest.remainingSec > 1) {
                curTest.remainingSec -= 1
            } else {
                curTest.remainingSec = 0
                finishTest()
            }
        }
    }

    fun flush() {
        if (pending > 0) {
            val d = today()
            days[d] = (days[d] ?: 0) + pending
            pending = 0
            save()
        }
    }

    fun totalSec(): Int = days.values.sum() + pending
    fun hoursLabel(): String = fmt1(totalSec() / 3600f)

    private fun testDays(): Set<Long> = tests.filter { it.passed }.map { it.day }.toSet()
    private fun counted(d: Long, td: Set<Long>): Boolean = (days[d] ?: 0) >= 300 || d in td

    fun streak(): Int {
        val td = testDays()
        var d = today()
        if (!counted(d, td)) d--
        var n = 0
        while (counted(d, td)) {
            n++
            d--
        }
        return n
    }

    fun record(): Int {
        val td = testDays()
        val ds = (days.filter { it.value >= 300 }.keys + td).toSortedSet()
        var best = 0
        var run = 0
        var prev = Long.MIN_VALUE
        for (d in ds) {
            run = if (d == prev + 1) run + 1 else 1
            if (run > best) best = run
            prev = d
        }
        return best
    }

    // ---------- Anki ----------

    fun dueWords(filter: String?): List<Word> {
        val t = today()
        return words.filter { w ->
            (filter == null || w.level == filter) && prog[w.key].let { it != null && !it.mastered && it.due <= t }
        }.sortedBy { prog[it.key]?.due ?: 0L }
    }

    fun introducedToday(): Int {
        val t = today()
        return prog.values.count { it.intro == t }
    }

    fun newLeft(): Int = if (newPaused) 0 else maxOf(0, limit - introducedToday())

    private fun nextNew(filter: String?): Word? {
        for (k in pinned) {
            val w = words.firstOrNull { it.key == k }
            if (w != null && prog[k] == null && (filter == null || w.level == filter)) return w
        }
        return words.firstOrNull { (filter == null || it.level == filter) && prog[it.key] == null }
    }

    fun pickCard(filter: String?): Word? {
        val d = dueWords(filter).firstOrNull()
        if (d != null) return d
        return if (newLeft() > 0) nextNew(filter) else null
    }

    private fun updatePause() {
        val n = dueWords(null).size
        if (n > 50) newPaused = true else if (n < 20) newPaused = false
    }

    fun checkTypedTranslation(trList: List<String>, input: String): Pair<Boolean, String?> {
        val x = norm(input)
        if (x.isEmpty()) return Pair(false, null)
        var bestD = Int.MAX_VALUE
        var bestT = ""
        for (t in trList) {
            val d = lev(x, norm(t))
            if (d < bestD) {
                bestD = d
                bestT = t
            }
        }
        val len = norm(bestT).length
        val allow = if (len >= 8) 2 else if (len >= 5) 1 else 0
        return if (bestD == 0) Pair(true, null) else if (bestD <= allow) Pair(true, bestT) else Pair(false, null)
    }

    /**
     * Исправленная ступень интервалов Anki:
     * INTERVALS = [1, 3, 7, 14, 30] (шаги s = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5).
     * При ошибке слово возвращается на шаг s = 1 (через 1 день), а при следующем верном ответе
     * сразу переходит на шаг s = 2 (через 3 дня), без двойного повтора по 1 дню!
     * После верного ответа на шаге s = 5 (30 дней) слово получает s = 6 (Закреплено).
     */
    private fun applyResult(key: String, ok: Boolean): String {
        val t = today()
        val old = prog[key]
        val intro = old?.intro ?: t
        val lapses = old?.lapses ?: 0
        val lastWrong = old?.lastWrong ?: 0L
        pinned.remove(key)
        val info: String
        if (ok) {
            val s = (old?.s ?: 0) + 1
            if (s >= 6) {
                prog[key] = Prog(6, Long.MAX_VALUE, true, intro, lapses, lastWrong)
                info = "Слово закреплено навсегда!"
            } else {
                val daysWait = INTERVALS[s - 1]
                prog[key] = Prog(s, t + daysWait, false, intro, lapses, lastWrong)
                info = "Следующий повтор через $daysWait дн."
            }
        } else {
            // Ставим s = 1 (интервал 1 день), чтобы завтра верный ответ перевёл слово сразу на 3 дня (s = 2)
            prog[key] = Prog(1, t + 1, false, intro, lapses + 1, t)
            info = "Повторим завтра (интервал 1 дн.)"
        }
        updatePause()
        save()
        return info
    }

    fun answer(w: Word, input: String?): Res {
        var ok = false
        var fixed: String? = null
        if (input != null) {
            val c = checkTypedTranslation(w.tr, input)
            ok = c.first
            fixed = c.second
        }
        val info = applyResult(w.key, ok)
        return Res(ok, fixed, info)
    }

    fun pin(key: String) {
        if (key !in pinned && prog[key] == null) pinned.add(key)
        save()
    }

    fun addCustom(word: String, tr: String, example: String): Boolean {
        val w = word.trim()
        val t = tr.split("|", ",").map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
        if (w.isEmpty() || t.isEmpty()) return false
        custom.add(Word(w.lowercase(), level, w.lowercase(), "", "", "", t, example.trim(), "", ""))
        rebuild()
        pin(w.lowercase())
        return true
    }

    // ---------- грамматика ----------

    fun finishUnit(id: String, ok: Boolean) {
        if (ok) {
            unitPassed[id] = true
            unitReview.remove(id)
        } else {
            unitReview[id] = true
        }
        save()
    }

    // ---------- тесты (Стартовый тест и 40-минутный Тест недели) ----------

    private fun isRecentlyUsedQuestion(qKey: String): Boolean {
        val lastDay = recentQKeys[qKey] ?: return false
        return (today() - lastDay) <= 28L
    }

    private fun prioritizeFreshQuestions(list: List<Q>, takeCount: Int): List<Q> {
        val fresh = list.filter { !isRecentlyUsedQuestion(it.key) }.shuffled()
        val old = list.filter { isRecentlyUsedQuestion(it.key) }.shuffled()
        return (fresh + old).take(takeCount)
    }

    private fun grammarQs(l: String, maxCount: Int): List<Q> {
        val all = UNITS.filter { it.level == l }.flatMap { u ->
            u.quiz.mapIndexed { idx, q ->
                Q(
                    key = "G_${u.id}_$idx",
                    section = "grammar",
                    level = l,
                    text = q.text,
                    options = q.options,
                    answer = q.answer,
                    tip = "${u.title} • Схема: ${u.formula}",
                    unitId = u.id
                )
            }
        }
        return prioritizeFreshQuestions(all, maxCount)
    }

    private fun readingQs(l: String, maxTexts: Int = 2): List<Q> {
        val selectedTexts = TEXTS.filter { it.level == l }.shuffled().take(maxTexts)
        return selectedTexts.flatMap { t ->
            t.questions.mapIndexed { idx, q ->
                Q(
                    key = "R_${t.id}_$idx",
                    section = "reading",
                    level = l,
                    text = q.text,
                    options = q.options,
                    answer = q.answer,
                    tip = "Ответ следует из текста «${t.title}»",
                    passage = "${t.title}\n\n${t.body}"
                )
            }
        }
    }

    private fun vocabQs(l: String, n: Int, includeTypedQuestions: Boolean): List<Q> {
        if (n <= 0) return emptyList()
        val pool = words.filter { it.level == l }
        val sortedPool = pool.sortedBy { if (isRecentlyUsedQuestion("V_${it.key}")) 1 else 0 }
        val chosenWords = sortedPool.shuffled().take(n)
        val out = ArrayList<Q>()

        chosenWords.forEachIndexed { index, w ->
            // В Тесте недели часть лексических вопросов требует прямого ввода перевода с клавиатуры,
            // часть — вставки слова в контекст примера, а часть — выбора значения (Раздел 9 ТЗ)
            val mode = if (!includeTypedQuestions) 0 else (index % 3)
            if (mode == 1) {
                // Ввод перевода слова на русский с клавиатуры
                out.add(
                    Q(
                        key = "V_TYPE_${w.key}",
                        section = "vocab",
                        level = l,
                        text = "Введите на русском перевод слова «${w.word}» ${if (w.ipa.isNotBlank()) w.ipa else ""}:",
                        options = emptyList(),
                        answer = 0,
                        acceptedTyped = w.tr,
                        tip = "${w.word} — ${w.tr.joinToString(", ")}",
                        wordKey = w.key
                    )
                )
            } else if (mode == 2 && w.example.contains(w.word, ignoreCase = true)) {
                // Вставка пропущенного слова в предложение-пример
                val blanked = w.example.replace(Regex(Regex.escape(w.word), RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE), "___")
                val distractors = words.filter { it.level == l && it.key != w.key }
                    .map { it.word }.distinct().shuffled().take(3)
                if (distractors.size == 3) {
                    val opts = (distractors + w.word).shuffled()
                    out.add(
                        Q(
                            key = "V_INS_${w.key}",
                            section = "vocab",
                            level = l,
                            text = "Вставьте подходящее по смыслу слово:\n«$blanked»\n(${w.exampleRu})",
                            options = opts,
                            answer = opts.indexOf(w.word),
                            tip = "${w.word} — ${w.tr.joinToString(", ")}",
                            wordKey = w.key
                        )
                    )
                }
            } else {
                val right = w.tr.first()
                val near = words.filter { it.level == l && it.key != w.key }.map { it.tr.first() }
                    .distinct().filter { it != right }.shuffled()
                val far = words.filter { it.key != w.key }.map { it.tr.first() }
                    .distinct().filter { it != right && it !in near }.shuffled()
                val wrong = (near + far).take(3)
                if (wrong.size >= 3) {
                    val opts = (wrong + right).shuffled()
                    out.add(
                        Q(
                            key = "V_${w.key}",
                            section = "vocab",
                            level = l,
                            text = "Что означает слово «${w.word}» ${if (w.ipa.isNotBlank()) w.ipa else ""}?",
                            options = opts,
                            answer = opts.indexOf(right),
                            tip = "${w.word} — ${w.tr.joinToString(", ")}",
                            wordKey = w.key
                        )
                    )
                }
            }
        }
        return out
    }

    fun startStartTest() {
        val qs = ArrayList<Q>()
        for (l in LEVELS.drop(1)) {
            val g = grammarQs(l, 3)
            qs.addAll(g)
            qs.addAll(vocabQs(l, 5 - g.size, includeTypedQuestions = false))
        }
        if (qs.isNotEmpty()) {
            test = TestSession("start", "A1", qs, 0)
            testOpenOnScreen = true
        }
    }

    fun weeklyTarget(): String = LEVELS.getOrElse(LEVELS.indexOf(level) + 1) { "C2" }
    fun weeklyAvailable(): Boolean = startDone && today() >= nextTest

    fun startOrResumeWeekly() {
        val existing = test
        if (existing != null && existing.kind == "weekly" && existing.result == null) {
            testOpenOnScreen = true
            return
        }
        val l = weeklyTarget()
        // По ТЗ (Раздел 9): грамматика — 20 вопросов, лексика — 25 вопросов, чтение — 2 текста с вопросами
        val qs = grammarQs(l, 20) + vocabQs(l, 25, includeTypedQuestions = true) + readingQs(l, maxTexts = 2)
        if (qs.isNotEmpty()) {
            test = TestSession("weekly", l, qs, 40 * 60)
            testOpenOnScreen = true
        }
    }

    fun isQuestionAnsweredCorrectly(s: TestSession, idx: Int): Boolean {
        val q = s.qs[idx]
        return if (q.options.isEmpty()) {
            checkTypedTranslation(q.acceptedTyped, s.typedAnswers[idx]).first
        } else {
            s.choiceAnswers[idx] == q.answer
        }
    }

    fun isCurrentQuestionFilled(s: TestSession): Boolean {
        val q = s.qs[s.index]
        return if (q.options.isEmpty()) {
            s.typedAnswers[s.index].isNotBlank()
        } else {
            s.choiceAnswers[s.index] >= 0
        }
    }

    fun nextQ() {
        val s = test ?: return
        if (s.result != null) return
        val cur = s.qs[s.index]
        if (s.index + 1 >= s.qs.size) {
            finishTest()
            return
        }
        if (s.kind == "start" && s.qs[s.index + 1].level != cur.level) {
            var a = s.index
            while (a > 0 && s.qs[a - 1].level == cur.level) a--
            var right = 0
            for (k in a..s.index) if (isQuestionAnsweredCorrectly(s, k)) right++
            if (right * 5 < (s.index - a + 1) * 4) {
                finishTest()
                return
            }
        }
        s.index += 1
    }

    fun finishTest() {
        val s = test ?: return
        if (s.result != null) return
        val last = if (s.kind == "start") s.index else s.qs.lastIndex
        val wrong = ArrayList<WrongItem>()
        val secTotal = HashMap<String, Int>()
        val secRight = HashMap<String, Int>()
        var right = 0
        val t = today()

        for (k in 0..last) {
            val q = s.qs[k]
            recentQKeys[q.key] = t
            secTotal[q.section] = (secTotal[q.section] ?: 0) + 1
            if (isQuestionAnsweredCorrectly(s, k)) {
                right++
                secRight[q.section] = (secRight[q.section] ?: 0) + 1
            } else {
                val userStr = if (q.options.isEmpty()) {
                    s.typedAnswers[k].ifBlank { "—" }
                } else {
                    val pick = s.choiceAnswers[k]
                    if (pick in q.options.indices) q.options[pick] else "—"
                }
                val rightStr = if (q.options.isEmpty()) {
                    q.acceptedTyped.joinToString(", ")
                } else {
                    q.options[q.answer]
                }
                wrong.add(WrongItem(q, userStr, rightStr))
            }
        }

        val count = last + 1
        val percent = if (count <= 0) 0 else right * 100 / count
        val secs = listOf("grammar", "vocab", "reading").filter { secTotal.containsKey(it) }
            .map { sec -> Pair(sec, (secRight[sec] ?: 0) * 100 / (secTotal[sec] ?: 1)) }
        val passed: Boolean
        var newLevel: String? = null

        if (s.kind == "start") {
            var best = "A0"
            for (l in LEVELS.drop(1)) {
                val ks = (0..last).filter { s.qs[it].level == l }
                if (ks.isEmpty()) break
                val r = ks.count { isQuestionAnsweredCorrectly(s, it) }
                if (r * 5 >= ks.size * 4) best = l else break
            }
            level = best
            startDone = true
            passed = true
            newLevel = best
        } else {
            passed = percent >= 75 && secs.all { it.second >= 60 }
            if (passed) {
                level = s.target
                newLevel = s.target
            }
        }
        nextTest = t + 7
        tests.add(TestRec(t, s.kind, s.target, percent, passed))
        for (item in wrong) {
            val q = item.q
            val wk = q.wordKey
            if (wk != null) applyResult(wk, false)
            val uid = q.unitId
            if (uid != null) unitReview[uid] = true
        }
        s.result = TestResult(percent, passed, newLevel, secs, wrong)
        updatePause()
        save()
    }

    // ---------- прогресс и медали ----------

    fun levelProgress(l: String): Float {
        val ws = words.filter { it.level == l }
        val us = UNITS.filter { it.level == l }
        val parts = ArrayList<Float>()
        if (ws.isNotEmpty()) parts.add(ws.count { prog[it.key]?.mastered == true }.toFloat() / ws.size)
        if (us.isNotEmpty()) parts.add(us.count { unitPassed[it.id] == true }.toFloat() / us.size)
        return if (parts.isEmpty()) 0f else parts.sum() / parts.size
    }

    fun nextLevel(): String = LEVELS.getOrElse(LEVELS.indexOf(level) + 1) { "C2" }

    fun nextProgressLabel(): String = "К ${nextLevel()}: ${(levelProgress(nextLevel()) * 100).toInt()}%"

    fun nextTestLabel(): String = if (!startDone) "стартовый" else LocalDate.ofEpochDay(nextTest).toString()

    fun weakItems(): List<String> {
        val us = UNITS.filter { unitReview[it.id] == true }.map { "${it.level}: ${it.title}" }
        val ws = prog.filter { it.value.lapses > 0 && !it.value.mastered && it.value.s <= 1 }
            .entries.sortedByDescending { it.value.lastWrong }.map { it.key }
        return (us + ws).take(10)
    }

    fun streakMedals(): List<Medal> {
        val r = record()
        return listOf(7, 14, 21, 28, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 210, 240, 270, 300, 330, 360).map { n ->
            Medal(
                "$n ${daysWord(n)} подряд",
                "Занимайся $n ${daysWord(n)} без пропусков (≥ 5 мин в день)",
                r >= n,
                r.toFloat() / n,
                "${minOf(r, n)} / $n дн."
            )
        }
    }

    fun timeMedals(): List<Medal> {
        val h = totalSec() / 3600f
        return listOf(1, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000).map { n ->
            Medal(
                if (n == 1) "Новичок: 1 час" else "$n часов практики",
                "Набери $n ч активных занятий в курсе",
                h >= n,
                h / n,
                "${fmt1(minOf(h, n.toFloat()))} / $n ч"
            )
        }
    }

    fun levelMedals(): List<Medal> = LEVELS.drop(1).map { l ->
        val done = LEVELS.indexOf(level) >= LEVELS.indexOf(l)
        Medal(
            "Уровень $l",
            "Пройди тест на уровень $l",
            done,
            if (done) 1f else 0f,
            if (done) "Получено" else "Не получено"
        )
    }
}

// ===================== АКТИВНОСТЬ =====================

class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {
    private var resumedState by mutableStateOf(false)
    private lateinit var vm: AppVm

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        vm = ViewModelProvider(this)[AppVm::class.java]
        setContent {
            MaterialTheme(colorScheme = lightColorScheme(primary = GreenC, background = BgC, surface = SurfC)) {
                EnglishTrackerRoot(vm, resumedState)
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        resumedState = true
    }

    override fun onPause() {
        super.onPause()
        resumedState = false
        vm.flush()
    }
}

// ===================== UI: ОБЩЕЕ =====================

@Composable
fun H(text: String, size: Int = 18, color: Color = InkC) {
    Text(text, fontSize = size.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = color)
}

@Composable
fun Sub(text: String, color: Color = MutedC, size: Int = 14) {
    Text(text, fontSize = size.sp, color = color, lineHeight = (size + 7).sp)
}

@Composable
fun Gap(h: Int) {
    Spacer(Modifier.height(h.dp))
}

@Composable
fun AppCard(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit) {
    Column(
        modifier.fillMaxWidth().clip(RoundedCornerShape(22.dp)).background(SurfC)
            .border(1.dp, LineC, RoundedCornerShape(22.dp)).padding(18.dp),
        content = content
    )
}

@Composable
fun Pill(text: String, selected: Boolean, onClick: () -> Unit) {
    Box(
        Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(50)).background(if (selected) GreenC else ChipC)
            .clickable(onClick = onClick).padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 9.dp)
    ) {
        Text(text, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium, color = if (selected) Color.White else InkC)
    }
}

@Composable
fun Bar(frac: Float, color: Color = GreenC) {
    Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(8.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp)).background(ChipC)) {
        Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(frac.coerceIn(0f, 1f)).fillMaxHeight().background(color))
    }
}

@Composable
fun Tile(label: String, value: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    Column(modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)).background(ChipC).padding(12.dp)) {
        Text(label, fontSize = 12.sp, color = MutedC)
        Gap(4)
        Text(value, fontSize = 16.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = InkC)
    }
}

@Composable
fun Primary(text: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, onClick: () -> Unit) {
    Button(
        onClick = onClick, enabled = enabled, modifier = modifier, shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = GreenC, contentColor = Color.White),
        contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 18.dp, vertical = 14.dp)
    ) { Text(text, fontSize = 16.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold) }
}

@Composable
fun Secondary(text: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, color: Color = InkC, onClick: () -> Unit) {
    OutlinedButton(
        onClick = onClick, modifier = modifier, shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
        contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 18.dp, vertical = 14.dp)
    ) { Text(text, fontSize = 16.sp, color = color) }
}

@Composable
fun OptionRow(text: String, bg: Color, selected: Boolean, enabled: Boolean = true, onClick: () -> Unit) {
    Box(
        Modifier.padding(top = 8.dp).fillMaxWidth().clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)).background(bg)
            .border(1.dp, if (selected) GreenC else Color.Transparent, RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
            .clickable(enabled = enabled, onClick = onClick).padding(14.dp)
    ) { Text(text, fontSize = 16.sp, color = InkC) }
}

@Composable
fun LevelFilter(sel: String?, onSel: (String?) -> Unit) {
    Row(Modifier.horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
        Pill("Все уровни", sel == null) { onSel(null) }
        LEVELS.forEach { l -> Pill(l, sel == l) { onSel(l) } }
    }
}

@Composable
fun AppTopBar(vm: AppVm) {
    Row(
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().background(SurfC).padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 12.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
    ) {
        Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Text("English", fontSize = 24.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = InkC)

val TABS: List<Pair<String, ImageVector>> = listOf(
    Pair("Прогресс", Icons.Filled.BarChart),
    Pair("Anki", Icons.Filled.Style),
    Pair("Словарь", Icons.Filled.Book),
    Pair("Грамматика", Icons.Filled.School),
    Pair("Профиль", Icons.Filled.Person)
)

@Composable
fun BottomBar(tab: Int, onSel: (Int) -> Unit) {
    NavigationBar(containerColor = SurfC) {
        TABS.forEachIndexed { i, t ->
            NavigationBarItem(
                selected = tab == i,
                onClick = { onSel(i) },
                icon = { Icon(t.second, contentDescription = null) },
                label = { Text(t.first, fontSize = 11.sp, maxLines = 1) },
                colors = NavigationBarItemDefaults.colors(
                    selectedIconColor = GreenC, selectedTextColor = GreenC, indicatorColor = GreenSoftC,
                    unselectedIconColor = MutedC, unselectedTextColor = MutedC
                )
            )
        }
    }
}

// ===================== UI: КОРЕНЬ =====================

@Composable
fun EnglishTrackerRoot(vm: AppVm, resumed: Boolean) {
    val ctx = LocalContext.current
    var tab by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(0) }
    val tts = remember { TextToSpeech(ctx, null) }
    DisposableEffect(Unit) { onDispose { tts.shutdown() } }
    val speak: (String, Boolean) -> Unit = { text, us ->
        tts.setLanguage(if (us) Locale.US else Locale.UK)
        tts.speak(text, TextToSpeech.QUEUE_FLUSH, null, "w")
        vm.touch()
    }
    // Автоучёт времени (пауза через 2 минуты без касаний или при сворачивании) + тик таймера открытого теста
    LaunchedEffect(resumed, tab, vm.testOpenOnScreen) {
        while (resumed) {
            delay(1000)
            vm.tick(countStudyTime = (tab != 4 || vm.testOpenOnScreen))
        }
    }
    BackHandler(enabled = vm.testOpenOnScreen) {
        // При нажатии «Назад» тест ставится на паузу и может быть продолжен с того же вопроса
        vm.testOpenOnScreen = false
    }
    Column(
        Modifier.fillMaxSize().background(BgC).pointerInput(Unit) {
            awaitPointerEventScope {
                while (true) {
                    awaitPointerEvent(PointerEventPass.Initial)
                    vm.touch()
                }
            }
        }
    ) {
        AppTopBar(vm)
        Box(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) {
            val s = vm.test
            if (vm.testOpenOnScreen && s != null) {
                TestBody(vm, s)
            } else {
                when (tab) {
                    0 -> ProgressScreen(vm)
                    1 -> AnkiScreen(vm, speak)
                    2 -> DictScreen(vm, speak)
                    3 -> GrammarScreen(vm, speak)
                    else -> ProfileScreen(vm)
                }
            }
        }
        if (!vm.testOpenOnScreen) BottomBar(tab) { tab = it }
    }
}
