@Composable
fun ProgressScreen(vm: AppVm) {
    LazyColumn(
        Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentPadding = PaddingValues(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)
    ) {
        item { TodayCard(vm) }
        item { TestCard(vm) }
        item { H("Прогресс по уровням", 20) }
        items(LEVELS) { l -> LevelCard(vm, l) }
    }
}

@Composable
fun TodayCard(vm: AppVm) {
    val due = vm.dueWords(null).size
    AppCard {
        H("Сегодня")
        Gap(10)
        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
            Tile("Повторы", "$due", Modifier.weight(1f))
            Tile("Новые слова", "${vm.introducedToday()} из ${vm.limit}", Modifier.weight(1f))
            Tile("Стрик", "${vm.streak()} дн.", Modifier.weight(1f))
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun TestCard(vm: AppVm) {
    val pausedTest = vm.test
    AppCard {
        if (!vm.startDone) {
            H("Стартовый тест")
            Gap(6)
            Sub("По 5 вопросов на уровень начиная с A1. Останавливается на первом непройденном уровне (< 4 из 5).")
            Gap(12)
            Primary("Начать стартовый тест") { vm.startStartTest() }
        } else if (pausedTest != null && pausedTest.kind == "weekly" && pausedTest.result == null) {
            val mins = pausedTest.remainingSec / 60
            val secs = pausedTest.remainingSec % 60
            H("Тест недели на паузе (${pausedTest.target})")
            Gap(6)
            Sub("Вопрос ${pausedTest.index + 1} из ${pausedTest.qs.size} • Осталось времени: %02d:%02d".format(mins, secs))
            Gap(12)
            Primary("Продолжить тест") { vm.startOrResumeWeekly() }
        } else {
            H("Тест недели")
            Gap(6)
            if (vm.weeklyAvailable()) {
                Sub("Доступен. Проверяет уровень ${vm.weeklyTarget()}: 20 вопросов грамматики, 25 слов и 2 текста (до 40 минут, порог 75% и ≥ 60% по разделам).")
                Gap(12)
                Primary("Начать тест на ${vm.weeklyTarget()}") { vm.startOrResumeWeekly() }
            } else {
                Sub("Следующий тест: ${vm.nextTestLabel()}")
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun LevelCard(vm: AppVm, l: String) {
    val ws = vm.words.filter { it.level == l }
    val m = ws.count { vm.prog[it.key]?.mastered == true }
    val us = UNITS.filter { it.level == l }
    val up = us.count { vm.unitPassed[it.id] == true }
    val p = vm.levelProgress(l)
    val cur = l == vm.level
    AppCard {
        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            Box(Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)).background(if (cur) GreenSoftC else ChipC).padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 8.dp)) {
                Text(l, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 18.sp, color = if (cur) GreenC else InkC)
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f))
            Text("${(p * 100).toInt()}%", fontSize = 22.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = GreenC)
        }
        Gap(12)
        Bar(p)
        Gap(12)
        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
            Tile("Слова", "$m из ${ws.size}", Modifier.weight(1f))
            Tile("Грамматика", "$up из ${us.size}", Modifier.weight(1f))
        }
    }
}

// ===================== UI: ANKI =====================

@Composable
fun AnkiScreen(vm: AppVm, speak: (String, Boolean) -> Unit) {
    var filter by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var card by remember { mutableStateOf(vm.pickCard(null)) }
    var input by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var res by remember { mutableStateOf<Res?>(null) }
    LaunchedEffect(filter) {
        card = vm.pickCard(filter)
        res = null
        input = ""
    }
    val due = vm.dueWords(filter).size
    val useUs = vm.accent == "US"
    Column(
        Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)
    ) {
        LevelFilter(filter) { filter = it }
        Sub("Повторы: $due  •  Новых сегодня осталось: ${vm.newLeft()}")
        val w = card
        if (w == null) {
            AppCard {
                H("На сегодня всё")
                Gap(6)
                Sub(
                    if (vm.newPaused) "В очереди накопилось больше 50 повторов: подача новых слов приостановлена до разбора очереди (< 20)."
                    else "Повторять пока нечего, а дневной лимит новых слов исчерпан. Загляни завтра или измени лимит в профиле."
                )
            }
        } else {
            val shownWord = if (useUs && w.us.isNotBlank()) w.us else w.word
            val p = vm.prog[w.key]
            val stepLabel = when {
                p == null -> "Новое слово"
                p.mastered -> "Закреплено"
                else -> "Ступень ${p.s}/5 (${INTERVALS[(p.s - 1).coerceIn(0, 4)]} дн.)"
            }
            AppCard {
                Row(
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    Text(
                        if (w.pos.isNotBlank()) "${w.level} • ${w.pos}" else w.level,
                        fontSize = 13.sp, color = BlueC,
                        modifier = Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)).background(BlueSoftC).padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
                    )
                    Text(stepLabel, fontSize = 12.sp, color = MutedC)
                }
                if (w.emoji.isNotBlank()) {
                    Gap(8)
                    Text(w.emoji, fontSize = 54.sp, modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.CenterHorizontally))
                }
                Gap(8)
                Text(
                    shownWord, fontSize = 36.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = InkC,
                    textAlign = TextAlign.Center, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                )
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.Center, verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    if (w.ipa.isNotBlank()) Text("${vm.accent} ${w.ipa}", fontSize = 18.sp, color = MutedC)
                    IconButton(onClick = { speak(shownWord, useUs) }) {
                        Icon(Icons.Filled.VolumeUp, contentDescription = "Озвучить", tint = GreenC)
                    }
                }
                if (w.us.isNotBlank() && w.us != w.word) {
                    Text(
                        "US: ${w.us}  •  UK: ${w.word}", fontSize = 14.sp, color = BlueC,
                        textAlign = TextAlign.Center, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    )
                }
                Gap(14)
                val r = res
                if (r == null) {
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = input, onValueChange = { input = it; vm.touch() }, singleLine = true,
                        label = { Text("Введите перевод на русский") }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
                        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(imeAction = ImeAction.Done),
                        keyboardActions = KeyboardActions(onDone = { if (input.isNotBlank()) res = vm.answer(w, input) })
                    )
                    Gap(12)
                    // По ТЗ (Раздел 5): «Не помню» до ввода, «Проверить» после ввода
                    if (input.isBlank()) {
                        Secondary("Не помню", Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), RedC) { res = vm.answer(w, null) }
                    } else {
                        Primary("Проверить", Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), true) { res = vm.answer(w, input) }
                    }
                } else {
                    Column(
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
                            .background(if (r.ok) GreenSoftC else RedSoftC).padding(14.dp)
                    ) {
                        val title = if (r.ok) {
                            if (r.fixed != null) "Верно (исправлено: ${r.fixed})" else "Верно"
                        } else "Неверно"
                        Text(title, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = if (r.ok) GreenC else RedC)
                        Gap(6)
                        Text("Перевод: ${w.tr.joinToString(", ")}", fontSize = 17.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, color = InkC)
                        if (w.example.isNotBlank()) {
                            Gap(8)
                            Text(w.example, fontSize = 15.sp, fontStyle = FontStyle.Italic, color = InkC)
                            if (w.exampleRu.isNotBlank()) Text(w.exampleRu, fontSize = 14.sp, color = MutedC)
                        }
                        Gap(8)
                        Text(r.info, fontSize = 13.sp, color = MutedC)
                    }
                    Gap(12)
                    Primary("Далее", Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                        card = vm.pickCard(filter)
                        res = null
                        input = ""
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Gap(8)
    }
}

// ===================== UI: СЛОВАРЬ =====================

@Composable
fun DictScreen(vm: AppVm, speak: (String, Boolean) -> Unit) {
    val ctx = LocalContext.current
    var q by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var filter by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var showAdd by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val picker = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument()) { uri: Uri? ->
        if (uri != null) {
            val text = runCatching {
                ctx.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() }
            }.getOrNull()
            val n = if (text == null) 0 else vm.importCsv(text)
            ctx.toast(if (n > 0) "Добавлено/обновлено слов: $n" else "Не удалось прочитать CSV-словарь")
        }
    }
    val list = remember(vm.words, q, filter) {
        val s = q.trim().lowercase()
        vm.words.filter { w ->
            (filter == null || w.level == filter) &&
                (s.isEmpty() || w.key.contains(s) || w.us.lowercase().contains(s) || w.tr.any { t -> t.lowercase().contains(s) })
        }
    }
    val levelCountText = if (filter == null) "Всего слов: ${vm.words.size} (A0–C2)"
    else "Норма уровня $filter: ${list.size} слов"

    LazyColumn(
        Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentPadding = PaddingValues(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
    ) {
        item {
            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Text("Словарь Oxford", fontSize = 24.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = InkC)
                    Sub(levelCountText)
                }
                IconButton(onClick = { showAdd = true }) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.Add, contentDescription = "Добавить слово", tint = GreenC)
                }
            }
        }
        item {
            Column {
                Secondary("Дополнить словарь из CSV-файла", Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) { picker.launch(arrayOf("*/*")) }
                Gap(6)
                Sub("Формат «;»: id;level;word;pos;ipa;us_word;translations_ru;translations_en;example;example_tr;emoji", size = 12)
            }
        }
        item {
            OutlinedTextField(
                value = q, onValueChange = { q = it }, singleLine = true, label = { Text("Поиск по английскому слову или переводу") },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
            )
        }
        item { LevelFilter(filter) { filter = it } }
        items(list, key = { it.key }) { w -> WordRow(vm, w, speak) }
    }
    if (showAdd) AddWordDialog(vm, "") { showAdd = false }
}

@Composable
fun WordRow(vm: AppVm, w: Word, speak: (String, Boolean) -> Unit) {
    val p = vm.prog[w.key]
    val st = when {
        p == null -> "Новое"
        p.mastered -> "Закреплено"
        else -> "В повторении (${INTERVALS[(p.s - 1).coerceIn(0, 4)]} дн.)"
    }
    val useUs = vm.accent == "US"
    val shown = if (useUs && w.us.isNotBlank()) w.us else w.word
    AppCard {
        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    if (w.emoji.isNotBlank()) {
                        Text(w.emoji, fontSize = 18.sp)
                        Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
                    }
                    Text(shown, fontSize = 20.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = InkC)
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                    Text(
                        w.level, fontSize = 12.sp, color = MutedC,
                        modifier = Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)).background(ChipC).padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 3.dp)
                    )
                }
                if (w.ipa.isNotBlank()) Sub("${w.pos}  ${w.ipa}", size = 13)
                if (w.us.isNotBlank() && w.us != w.word) {
                    Text("US: ${w.us} • UK: ${w.word}", fontSize = 12.sp, color = BlueC)
                }
                Gap(2)
                Text(w.tr.joinToString(", "), fontSize = 16.sp, color = InkC)
                if (w.example.isNotBlank()) {
                    Gap(4)
                    Text(w.example, fontSize = 13.sp, fontStyle = FontStyle.Italic, color = MutedC)
                }
            }
            Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End) {
                IconButton(onClick = { speak(shown, useUs) }) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.VolumeUp, contentDescription = null, tint = GreenC)
                }
                Text(st, fontSize = 11.sp, color = if (p?.mastered == true) GreenC else MutedC)
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun AddWordDialog(vm: AppVm, preset: String, onClose: () -> Unit) {
    val ctx = LocalContext.current
    var w by remember { mutableStateOf(preset) }
    var tr by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var ex by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = onClose,
        title = { Text("Новое слово") },
        text = {
            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                OutlinedTextField(w, { w = it }, label = { Text("Слово (English)") }, singleLine = true)
                OutlinedTextField(tr, { tr = it }, label = { Text("Перевод (варианты через | или запятую)") }, singleLine = true)
                OutlinedTextField(ex, { ex = it }, label = { Text("Пример (необязательно)") })
            }
        },
        confirmButton = {
            TextButton(onClick = {
                if (vm.addCustom(w, tr, ex)) {
                    ctx.toast("Слово добавлено в очередь Anki")
                    onClose()
                }
            }) { Text("Добавить") }
        },
        dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = onClose) { Text("Отмена") } }
    )
}

// ===================== UI: ГРАММАТИКА, ТЕКСТЫ И ТЕРМИНЫ =====================

@Composable
fun GrammarScreen(vm: AppVm, speak: (String, Boolean) -> Unit) {
    var mode by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(0) }
    var unitId by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var textId by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var lvl by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var popupTerm by remember { mutableStateOf<Term?>(null) }

    val u = UNITS.firstOrNull { it.id == unitId }
    val tx = TEXTS.firstOrNull { it.id == textId }
    val ctx = LocalContext.current

    if (u != null) {
        UnitScreen(vm, u, onTermTap = { popupTerm = it }) { unitId = null }
    } else if (tx != null) {
        TextScreen(vm, tx, speak) { textId = null }
    } else {
        Column(
            Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(16.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
        ) {
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                Pill("Правила (35)", mode == 0) { mode = 0 }
                Pill("Тексты (21)", mode == 1) { mode = 1 }
                Pill("База (25)", mode == 2) { mode = 2 }
            }
            if (mode == 0) {
                LevelFilter(lvl) { lvl = it }
                UNITS.filter { lvl == null || it.level == lvl }.forEach { uu ->
                    UnitRow(vm, uu) { unitId = uu.id }
                }
            } else if (mode == 1) {
                LevelFilter(lvl) { lvl = it }
                Sub("Нажимай на любое слово в тексте: приложение найдёт его начальную форму, покажет перевод, озвучит и добавит в Anki.")
                TEXTS.filter { lvl == null || it.level == lvl }.forEach { t ->
                    Row(
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clip(RoundedCornerShape(22.dp)).background(SurfC)
                            .border(1.dp, LineC, RoundedCornerShape(22.dp)).clickable { textId = t.id }.padding(18.dp),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                    ) {
                        Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                            Text(t.title, fontSize = 17.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, color = InkC)
                            Sub("Уровень ${t.level} • ${t.questions.size} вопроса", size = 13)
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                Sub("Понятные объяснения с нуля: звуки, звонкие и глухие согласные, части речи и члены предложения.")
                TERMS.forEach { t ->
                    AppCard {
                        H(t.title, 17)
                        Gap(6)
                        Text(t.explain, fontSize = 15.sp, color = InkC, lineHeight = 22.sp)
                        Gap(6)
                        Sub("Пример: ${t.example}", size = 13)
                        Gap(8)
                        Secondary("Открыть в Википедии", Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                            runCatching {
                                ctx.startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/" + t.wiki)))
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Gap(8)
        }
    }

    if (popupTerm != null) {
        val t = popupTerm!!
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { popupTerm = null },
            title = { Text(t.title, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) },
            text = {
                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    Text(t.explain, fontSize = 15.sp, color = InkC, lineHeight = 22.sp)
                    Sub("Пример: ${t.example}", size = 13)
                }
            },
            confirmButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = {
                    runCatching {
                        ctx.startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/" + t.wiki)))
                    }
                }) { Text("В Википедии") }
            },
            dismissButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = { popupTerm = null }) { Text("Понятно") }
            }
        )
    }
}

@Composable
fun UnitRow(vm: AppVm, u: GUnit, onOpen: () -> Unit) {
    val status = when {
        vm.unitReview[u.id] == true -> "Повторить"
        vm.unitPassed[u.id] == true -> "Пройден"
        else -> "Не начат"
    }
    val statusColor = when (status) {
        "Повторить" -> AmberC
        "Пройден" -> GreenC
        else -> MutedC
    }
    Row(
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clip(RoundedCornerShape(22.dp)).background(SurfC)
            .border(1.dp, LineC, RoundedCornerShape(22.dp)).clickable(onClick = onOpen).padding(18.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
    ) {
        Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Text(u.title, fontSize = 17.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, color = InkC)
            Text("${u.level} • $status", fontSize = 13.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium, color = statusColor)
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun UnitScreen(vm: AppVm, u: GUnit, onTermTap: (Term) -> Unit, onBack: () -> Unit) {
    val picks = remember(u.id) { mutableStateListOf<Int>().also { l -> repeat(u.quiz.size) { l.add(-1) } } }
    var checked by remember(u.id) { mutableStateOf(false) }
    BackHandler(onBack = onBack)

    // Подсветка базовых терминов прямо в тексте правила (Раздел 8 ТЗ)
    val annotatedRule = remember(u.rule) {
        buildAnnotatedString {
            append(u.rule)
            for (term in TERMS) {
                for (kw in term.keywords) {
                    val regex = Regex(Regex.escape(kw), RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
                    regex.findAll(u.rule).forEach { m ->
                        addStyle(
                            SpanStyle(
                                color = GreenC,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                                textDecoration = TextDecoration.Underline
                            ),
                            m.range.first,
                            m.range.last + 1
                        )
                        addStringAnnotation("TERM", term.title, m.range.first, m.range.last + 1)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Column(
        Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
    ) {
        TextButton(onClick = onBack) { Text("← К списку юнитов", color = GreenC) }
        Text("${u.level} • ${u.title}", fontSize = 22.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = InkC)
        AppCard {
            H("Правило")
            Sub("Подчёркнутые термины кликабельны — нажми для простого объяснения.", size = 12)
            Gap(6)
            ClickableText(
                text = annotatedRule,
                style = TextStyle(fontSize = 16.sp, color = InkC, lineHeight = 24.sp),
                onClick = { offset ->
                    annotatedRule.getStringAnnotations("TERM", offset, offset).firstOrNull()?.let { ann ->
                        TERMS.firstOrNull { it.title == ann.item }?.let(onTermTap)
                    }
                }
            )
        }
        AppCard {
            H("Схема")
            Gap(8)
            Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)).background(GreenSoftC).padding(14.dp)) {
                Text(u.formula, fontSize = 15.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, color = GreenC)
            }
        }
        AppCard {
            H("Примеры")
            Gap(6)
            u.examples.forEach { ex ->
                Text(ex, fontSize = 15.sp, color = InkC, lineHeight = 22.sp)
                Gap(6)
            }
        }
        AppCard {
            H("Частая ошибка", 18, RedC)
            Gap(6)
            Text(u.mistake, fontSize = 15.sp, color = InkC, lineHeight = 22.sp)
        }
        H("Мини-тест (нужно минимум 4 из 5)", 20)
        u.quiz.forEachIndexed { qi, q ->
            AppCard {
                Text("${qi + 1}. ${q.text}", fontSize = 17.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, color = InkC)
                q.options.forEachIndexed { oi, o ->
                    val sel = picks[qi] == oi
                    val bg = when {
                        !checked -> if (sel) GreenSoftC else ChipC
                        oi == q.answer -> GreenSoftC
                        sel -> RedSoftC
                        else -> ChipC
                    }
                    OptionRow(o, bg, sel && !checked, !checked) { picks[qi] = oi }
                }
            }
        }
        val score = u.quiz.indices.count { picks[it] == u.quiz[it].answer }
        if (!checked) {
            Primary("Проверить мини-тест", Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), picks.all { it >= 0 }) {
                checked = true
                vm.finishUnit(u.id, score >= 4)
            }
        } else {
            AppCard {
                H("Результат: $score из ${u.quiz.size}", 20, if (score >= 4) GreenC else RedC)
                Gap(4)
                Sub(if (score >= 4) "Юнит засчитан!" else "Нужно минимум 4 верных ответа. Разбери ошибки и попробуй ещё раз.")
            }
            Secondary("Пройти ещё раз", Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                for (i in picks.indices) picks[i] = -1
                checked = false
            }
        }
        Gap(16)
    }
}

@Composable
fun TextScreen(vm: AppVm, t: TextItem, speak: (String, Boolean) -> Unit, onBack: () -> Unit) {
    var tapped by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    val picks = remember(t.id) { mutableStateListOf<Int>().also { l -> repeat(t.questions.size) { l.add(-1) } } }
    var checked by remember(t.id) { mutableStateOf(false) }

    BackHandler(onBack = onBack)
    Column(
        Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
    ) {
        TextButton(onClick = onBack) { Text("← К текстам", color = GreenC) }
        Text(t.title, fontSize = 24.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = InkC)
        Sub("Уровень ${t.level} • Нажми на любое слово в тексте для перевода и озвучки")
        AppCard {
            ClickableText(
                text = AnnotatedString(t.body),
                style = TextStyle(fontSize = 19.sp, lineHeight = 30.sp, color = InkC),
                onClick = { off ->
                    vm.touch()
                    tapped = wordAt(t.body, off)
                }
            )
        }
        if (t.questions.isNotEmpty()) {
            H("Проверка понимания текста", 18)
            t.questions.forEachIndexed { qi, q ->
                AppCard {
                    Text("${qi + 1}. ${q.text}", fontSize = 16.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, color = InkC)
                    q.options.forEachIndexed { oi, o ->
                        val sel = picks[qi] == oi
                        val bg = when {
                            !checked -> if (sel) GreenSoftC else ChipC
                            oi == q.answer -> GreenSoftC
                            sel -> RedSoftC
                            else -> ChipC
                        }
                        OptionRow(o, bg, sel && !checked, !checked) { picks[qi] = oi }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!checked) {
                Primary("Проверить ответы по тексту", Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), picks.all { it >= 0 }) {
                    checked = true
                }
            } else {
                val right = t.questions.indices.count { picks[it] == t.questions[it].answer }
                AppCard {
                    H("Верно: $right из ${t.questions.size}", 18, if (right == t.questions.size) GreenC else AmberC)
                }
            }
        }
        Gap(12)
    }
    val w = tapped
    if (w != null) WordDialog(vm, w, speak) { tapped = null }
}

@Composable
fun WordDialog(vm: AppVm, w: String, speak: (String, Boolean) -> Unit, onClose: () -> Unit) {
    val ctx = LocalContext.current
    val found = remember(w, vm.words) { findWordInDict(w, vm.words) }
    var tr by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    val useUs = vm.accent == "US"
    AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = onClose,
        title = {
            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Text(found?.word ?: w, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                IconButton(onClick = { speak(found?.word ?: w, useUs) }) {
                    Icon(Icons.Filled.VolumeUp, contentDescription = "Озвучить", tint = GreenC)
                }
            }
        },
        text = {
            if (found != null) {
                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                    if (found.word != w) {
                        Sub("В тексте: $w → словарная форма: ${found.word} (${found.level})", size = 12)
                    }
                    if (found.ipa.isNotBlank()) Sub("${found.pos}  ${found.ipa}")
                    Text(found.tr.joinToString(", "), fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, color = InkC)
                    if (found.example.isNotBlank()) {
                        Gap(4)
                        Text(found.example, fontSize = 14.sp, fontStyle = FontStyle.Italic, color = InkC)
                        if (found.exampleRu.isNotBlank()) Sub(found.exampleRu, size = 13)
                    }
                }
            } else {
                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    Text("Слова «$w» ещё нет в словаре. Введи перевод, чтобы сразу отправить его в Anki:", fontSize = 14.sp, color = MutedC)
                    OutlinedTextField(tr, { tr = it }, label = { Text("Перевод на русский") }, singleLine = true)
                }
            }
        },
        confirmButton = {
            TextButton(onClick = {
                if (found != null) {
                    vm.pin(found.key)
                    ctx.toast("Слово «${found.word}» поставлено первым в очередь Anki")
                    onClose()
                } else if (vm.addCustom(w, tr, "")) {
                    ctx.toast("Слово «$w» добавлено в Anki")
                    onClose()
                }
            }) { Text(if (found != null) "В Anki" else "Добавить в Anki") }
        },
        dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = onClose) { Text("Закрыть") } }
    )
}

// ===================== UI: ТЕСТЫ =====================

@Composable
fun TestBody(vm: AppVm, s: TestSession) {
    val r = s.result
    if (r != null) {
        ResultView(vm, s, r)
    } else {
        val q = s.qs[s.index]
        val left = s.remainingSec
        Column(
            Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(16.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
        ) {
            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Text(
                    if (s.kind == "start") "Стартовый тест • Уровень ${q.level}" else "Тест недели • ${s.target}",
                    fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = InkC, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                )
                if (s.initialSec > 0) {
                    Text(
                        "%02d:%02d".format(left / 60, left % 60), fontSize = 20.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        color = if (left < 300) RedC else GreenC
                    )
                }
            }
            Sub("Вопрос ${s.index + 1} из ${s.qs.size}  •  ${sectionName(q.section)}")
            Bar((s.index + 1).toFloat() / s.qs.size)
            val ps = q.passage
            if (ps != null) {
                AppCard { Text(ps, fontSize = 15.sp, color = InkC, lineHeight = 23.sp) }
            }
            AppCard {
                Text(q.text, fontSize = 19.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, color = InkC)
                if (q.options.isEmpty()) {
                    Gap(10)
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = s.typedAnswers[s.index],
                        onValueChange = { s.typedAnswers[s.index] = it; vm.touch() },
                        label = { Text("Введите перевод на русский") },
                        singleLine = true,
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
                    )
                } else {
                    q.options.forEachIndexed { i, o ->
                        val sel = s.choiceAnswers[s.index] == i
                        OptionRow(o, if (sel) GreenSoftC else ChipC, sel) {
                            vm.touch()
                            s.choiceAnswers[s.index] = i
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                Secondary(if (s.kind == "weekly") "Пауза" else "Выйти", Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    if (s.kind == "weekly") {
                        vm.testOpenOnScreen = false
                    } else {
                        vm.test = null
                        vm.testOpenOnScreen = false
                    }
                }
                Primary(
                    if (s.index + 1 >= s.qs.size) "Завершить" else "Далее",
                    Modifier.weight(1f),
                    vm.isCurrentQuestionFilled(s)
                ) { vm.nextQ() }
            }
            Gap(16)
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun ResultView(vm: AppVm, s: TestSession, r: TestResult) {
    Column(
        Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
    ) {
        AppCard {
            val title = if (r.passed) {
                if (s.kind == "start") "Уровень определён" else "Тест недели пройден!"
            } else "Тест недели не пройден"
            H(title, 22, if (r.passed) GreenC else RedC)
            Text("${r.percent}%", fontSize = 48.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = InkC)
            r.sections.forEach { sec -> Sub("${sectionName(sec.first)}: ${sec.second}%", size = 15) }
            if (r.newLevel != null) {
                Gap(8)
                H("Твой уровень: ${r.newLevel}", 18, GreenC)
                Sub("Следующий шаг: открой вкладку Anki и Грамматику уровня ${vm.nextLevel()}.")
            }
            if (s.kind == "weekly" && !r.passed) {
                Gap(8)
                Sub("Для прохождения нужно ≥ 75% в целом и ≥ 60% в каждом разделе. Неверные слова отправлены в Anki на завтра, а темы помечены «Повторить».")
            }
        }
        if (r.wrong.isNotEmpty()) {
            H("Разбор ошибок (${r.wrong.size})", 20)
            r.wrong.forEach { item ->
                AppCard {
                    Text(item.q.text, fontSize = 16.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, color = InkC)
                    Gap(6)
                    Text("Твой ответ: ${item.userText}", fontSize = 15.sp, color = RedC)
                    Text("Верно: ${item.rightText}", fontSize = 15.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, color = GreenC)
                    Gap(4)
                    Sub(item.q.tip, size = 13)
                }
            }
        }
        Primary("Готово", Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
            vm.test = null
            vm.testOpenOnScreen = false
        }
        Gap(16)
    }
}

// ===================== UI: ПРОФИЛЬ =====================

@Composable
fun ActivityGrid(vm: AppVm) {
    val t = vm.today()
    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp)) {
        for (r in 0 until 4) {
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp)) {
                for (c in 0 until 7) {
                    val d = t - (27 - (r * 7 + c))
                    val sec = vm.days[d] ?: 0
                    val min = if (sec <= 0) 0 else maxOf(1, (sec + 30) / 60)
                    val bg = if (sec <= 0) ChipC else if (sec >= 300) GreenMidC else GreenSoftC
                    Box(
                        Modifier.weight(1f).height(28.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)).background(bg),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        if (min > 0) Text("${min}м", fontSize = 12.sp, color = GreenC)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun MedalCard(m: Medal) {
    AppCard {
        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            Box(
                Modifier.size(48.dp).clip(CircleShape).background(if (m.done) AmberSoftC else ChipC),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Icon(
                    if (m.done) Icons.Filled.EmojiEvents else Icons.Filled.Lock, contentDescription = null,
                    tint = if (m.done) AmberC else MutedC
                )
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.width(14.dp))
            Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Text(m.title, fontSize = 17.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, color = if (m.done) InkC else MutedC)
                Sub(m.desc, size = 13)
                Gap(8)
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Box(Modifier.weight(1f)) { Bar(m.frac, if (m.done) AmberC else GreenC) }
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                    Text(m.label, fontSize = 12.sp, color = MutedC)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun ProfileScreen(vm: AppVm) {
    val ctx = LocalContext.current
    var mt by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { vm.flush() }
    val exp = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/json")) { uri: Uri? ->
        if (uri != null) {
            vm.flush()
            val ok = runCatching {
                ctx.contentResolver.openOutputStream(uri)?.use { it.write(vm.exportJson().toByteArray()) }
            }.isSuccess
            ctx.toast(if (ok) "Резервная копия сохранена" else "Не удалось сохранить файл")
        }
    }
    val imp = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument()) { uri: Uri? ->
        if (uri != null) {
            val text = runCatching {
                ctx.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.bufferedReader()?.use { it.readText() }
            }.getOrNull()
            ctx.toast(if (text != null && vm.importBackup(text)) "Прогресс восстановлен" else "Не удалось прочитать копию")
        }
    }
    val medals = when (mt) {
        0 -> vm.streakMedals()
        1 -> vm.timeMedals()
        else -> vm.levelMedals()
    }
    val weak = vm.weakItems()
    LazyColumn(
        Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentPadding = PaddingValues(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)
    ) {
        item {
            AppCard {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Text("English", fontSize = 24.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = InkC, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                    Box(Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)).background(GreenSoftC).padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 8.dp)) {
                        Text("Уровень ${vm.level}", color = GreenC, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    }
                }
                Gap(10)
                Sub("Часы: ${vm.hoursLabel()} ч • След. тест: ${vm.nextTestLabel()} • ${vm.nextProgressLabel()}", size = 15)
            }
        }
        item {
            AppCard {
                H("Слабые темы и слова (до 10)", 20)
                Gap(8)
                if (weak.isEmpty()) {
                    Sub("Пока нет ошибок.", size = 15)
                } else {
                    weak.forEach { x ->
                        Text(x, fontSize = 15.sp, color = RedC, lineHeight = 22.sp)
                        Gap(4)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        item {
            AppCard {
                H("Статистика и календарь активности", 20)
                Gap(12)
                Sub("Всего времени: ${vm.hoursLabel()} ч • Стрик: ${vm.streak()} дн. (рекорд: ${vm.record()} дн.)", size = 16)
                Gap(16)
                ActivityGrid(vm)
            }
        }
        item { H("Достижения и медали", 22) }
        item {
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                Pill("Стрик (15)", mt == 0) { mt = 0 }
                Pill("Время (8)", mt == 1) { mt = 1 }
                Pill("Уровни (6)", mt == 2) { mt = 2 }
            }
        }
        items(medals) { m -> MedalCard(m) }
        item {
            AppCard {
                H("Настройки")
                Gap(10)
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Text("Новых слов в день", fontSize = 16.sp, color = InkC, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                    OutlinedButton(
                        onClick = { vm.limit = (vm.limit - 1).coerceAtLeast(0); vm.save() },
                        contentPadding = PaddingValues(0.dp), modifier = Modifier.size(40.dp)
                    ) { Text("−", fontSize = 18.sp) }
                    Text("${vm.limit}", fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = InkC, modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 14.dp))
                    OutlinedButton(
                        onClick = { vm.limit = (vm.limit + 1).coerceAtMost(30); vm.save() },
                        contentPadding = PaddingValues(0.dp), modifier = Modifier.size(40.dp)
                    ) { Text("+", fontSize = 18.sp) }
                }
                Gap(12)
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Text("Озвучка и вариант", fontSize = 16.sp, color = InkC, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                    Pill("UK", vm.accent == "UK") { vm.accent = "UK"; vm.save() }
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                    Pill("US", vm.accent == "US") { vm.accent = "US"; vm.save() }
                }
                Gap(12)
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                    Secondary("Экспорт JSON", Modifier.weight(1f)) { exp.launch("backup-${LocalDate.now()}.json") }
                    Secondary("Импорт JSON", Modifier.weight(1f)) { imp.launch(arrayOf("*/*")) }
                }
            }
        }
        item { Gap(8) }
    }
}
